_about: Per-platform numbers shared by sixthgen-texture and sixthgen-model-check. Prose and sources: platforms.md. 'inference' marks numbers we chose, not ones a source stated.

dc.name: Dreamcast
dc.texture_budget_source: inference: 8 MB minus a 640x480 16-bit double framebuffer (~1.2 MB) and KOS PVR vertex buffers and OPBs (~1 MB). Read pvr_mem_available() on the device for the real figure
dc.translucent_share_source: inference: the PVR 'dies' with too much transparency (Elias); no number was stated
dc.scene_verts_60fps_source: inference: the research's recommendation of 10-15k, from Shenmue's <=14k (no frame rate stated)

ps2.name: PlayStation 2
ps2.framebuffer_source: inference: 640x448, 16-bit double buffer + 16-bit Z. A 32-bit setup takes about 3.4 MB
ps2.texture_budget_source: inference: GS 4 MB minus framebuffer_bytes, resident at once. Streaming textures per frame can exceed it

gc.name: GameCube
gc.texture_budget_source: inference: textures stream from the 24 MB main RAM through a 1 MB TMEM cache; 8 MB is a starting share, tune per project

xbox.name: Original Xbox
xbox.texture_budget_source: inference: unified 64 MB shared with code and audio; 24 MB is a starting share, tune per project
xbox.max_texture_source: unverified: the research could not confirm the NV2A maximum; 1024 is the safe ceiling
